verdict.rationale: A and C make opposing schedule tradeoffs. A arrives only 70 minutes before the Wednesday reception but provides a much safer Friday buffer; C arrives comfortably early Wednesday and costs less, but departs only 45 minutes after the stated Friday closeout. Whether either tight connection between airport, hotel, and meeting venue is acceptable depends on omitted location/transfer details and the traveler's risk tolerance. B and D arrive after the Wednesday reception begins.
